patrol.label: Nissan Patrol Super Safari VTC (Y61, 4.8 L I6 petrol)
patrol.name: Nissan Patrol VTC (Y61)
sources: auto-data.net Nissan Patrol Y61 4.8 i 24V (245/251 hp): 185 kW @ 4800, 420 Nm @ 3600, kerb 2410-2640 kg
carexpert.com.au Patrol Y61 specs: wheelbase 2970 mm
ASSUMPTION: 5-speed auto ratios (RE5R05A family), final 3.9, low range 2.02
patrol._driftSetup: Hajwala / drift setup (DECISIONS U5): 4H + rear locker at start (welded-diff behaviour; 2H digs in at the soft dune spawn, press 1 for 2H on asphalt), steering lock 33 -> 48 deg (angle kit) with little high-speed reduction so counter-steer stays available, rear anti-roll bar much stiffer than the front (more rear lateral load transfer = the rear lets go first), slightly stiffer rear springs, rear tyre grip x0.95 (rears pumped up / harder compound; x0.9 bled too much speed in tests/drift.test.ts), hydraulic-style handbrake 6500 Nm that locks the rears for entries.
